verses.original: Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεός δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει καὶ ἐσήμανεν ἀποστείλας διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου αὐτοῦ τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννῃ
verses.transliteration: Apokalypsis Iēsou Christou hēn edōken autō ho Theos deixai tois doulois autou ha dei genesthai en tachei kai esēmanen aposteilas dia tou angelou autou tō doulō autou Iōannē
verses.literal: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John
verses.literalPt: REVELAÇÃO de Jesus Cristo, a qual Deus lhe deu, para mostrar aos seus servos as coisas que brevemente devem acontecer; e pelo seu anjo as enviou, e as notificou a João seu servo;

verses.original: ὃς ἐμαρτύρησεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὅσα εἶδεν
verses.transliteration: hos emartyrēsen ton logon tou Theou kai tēn martyrian Iēsou Christou hosa eiden
verses.literal: who testifies to everything he saw This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: O qual testificou da palavra de Deus, e do testemunho de Jesus Cristo, e de tudo o que tem visto.

verses.original: Μακάριος ὁ ἀναγινώσκων καὶ οἱ ἀκούοντες τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας καὶ τηροῦντες τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς ἐγγύς
verses.transliteration: Makarios ho anaginōskōn kai hoi akouontes tous logous tēs prophēteias kai tērountes ta en autē gegrammena ho gar kairos engys
verses.literal: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it because the time is near
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurado aquele que lê, e os que ouvem as palavras desta profecia, e guardam as coisas que nela estão escritas; porque o tempo está próximo.

verses.original: Ἰωάννης Ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις ταῖς ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἑπτὰ Πνευμάτων ἃ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Iōannēs Tais hepta ekklēsiais tais en tē Asia Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo ho ōn kai ho ēn kai ho erchomenos kai apo tōn hepta Pneumatōn ha enōpion tou thronou autou
verses.literal: John To the seven churches in the province of Asia Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come and from the seven spirits before His throne
verses.literalPt: João, às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia: Graça e paz seja convosco da parte daquele que é, e que era, e que há de vir, e da dos sete espíritos que estão diante do seu trono;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστός ὁ πρωτότοκος τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς Τῷ ἀγαπῶντι ἡμᾶς καὶ λύσαντι ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai apo Iēsou Christou ho martys ho pistos ho prōtotokos tōn nekrōn kai ho archōn tōn basileōn tēs gēs Tō agapōnti hēmas kai lysanti hēmas ek tōn hamartiōn hēmōn en tō haimati autou
verses.literal: and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness the firstborn from the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood
verses.literalPt: E da parte de Jesus Cristo, que é a fiel testemunha, o primogênito dentre os mortos e o príncipe dos reis da terra. Àquele que nos amou, e em seu sangue nos lavou dos nossos pecados,

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς βασιλείαν ἱερεῖς τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρὶ αὐτοῦ αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: kai epoiēsen hēmas basileian hiereis tō Theō kai Patri autou autō hē doxa kai to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: who has made us to be a kingdom priests to His God and Father to Him be the glory and power forever and ever Amen
verses.literalPt: E nos fez reis e sacerdotes para Deus e seu Pai; a ele glória e poder para todo o sempre. Amém.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν πᾶς ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ οἵτινες αὐτὸν ἐξεκέντησαν καὶ κόψονται ἐπ’ αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς ναί ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Idou erchetai meta tōn nephelōn kai opsetai auton pas ophthalmos kai hoitines auton exekentēsan kai kopsontai ep’ auton pasai hai phylai tēs gēs nai amēn
verses.literal: Behold He is coming with the clouds and every eye will see Him even those who pierced Him And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him So shall it be Amen
verses.literalPt: Eis que vem com as nuvens, e todo o olho o verá, até os mesmos que o traspassaram; e todas as tribos da terra se lamentarão sobre ele. Sim. Amém.

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεός ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ὁ Παντοκράτωρ
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi to Alpha kai to Ō legei Kyrios ho Theos ho ōn kai ho ēn kai ho erchomenos ho Pantokratōr
verses.literal: I am the Alpha and the Omega says the Lord God who is and was and is to come the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim, diz o Senhor, que é, e que era, e que há de vir, o Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ συνκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ἐν Ἰησοῦ ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egō Iōannēs ho adelphos hymōn kai synkoinōnos en tē thlipsei kai basileia kai hypomonē en Iēsou egenomēn en tē nēsō tē kaloumenē Patmō dia ton logon tou Theou kai tēn martyrian Iēsou
verses.literal: I John your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus
verses.literalPt: Eu, João, que também sou vosso irmão, e companheiro na aflição, e no reino, e paciência de Jesus Cristo, estava na ilha chamada Patmos, por causa da palavra de Deus, e pelo testemunho de Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: ἐγενόμην ἐν Πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἤκουσα ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος
verses.transliteration: egenomēn en Pneumati en tē kyriakē hēmera kai ēkousa opisō mou phōnēn megalēn hōs salpingos
verses.literal: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet
verses.literalPt: Eu fui arrebatado no Espírito no dia do Senhor, e ouvi detrás de mim uma grande voz, como de trombeta,

verses.original: λεγούσης Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν
verses.transliteration: legousēs Ho blepeis grapson eis biblion kai pempson tais hepta ekklēsiais eis Epheson kai eis Smyrnan kai eis Pergamon kai eis Thyateira kai eis Sardeis kai eis Philadelpheian kai eis Laodikeian
verses.literal: saying Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches to Ephesus - Smyrna - Pergamum - Thyatira - Sardis - Philadelphia and Laodicea
verses.literalPt: Que dizia: Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o primeiro e o derradeiro; e o que vês, escreve-o num livro, e envia-o às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia: a Éfeso, e a Esmirna, e a Pérgamo, e a Tiatira, e a Sardes, e a Filadélfia, e a Laodicéia.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα βλέπειν τὴν φωνὴν ἥτις ἐλάλει μετ’ ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐπιστρέψας εἶδον ἑπτὰ λυχνίας χρυσᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai epestrepsa blepein tēn phōnēn hētis elalei met’ emou kai epistrepsas eidon hepta lychnias chrysas
verses.literal: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me And having turned I saw seven golden lampstands
verses.literalPt: E virei-me para ver quem falava comigo. E, virando-me, vi sete castiçais de ouro;

verses.original: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν λυχνιῶν ὅμοιον υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ἐνδεδυμένον ποδήρη καὶ περιεζωσμένον πρὸς τοῖς μαστοῖς ζώνην χρυσᾶν
verses.transliteration: kai en mesō tōn lychniōn homoion huion anthrōpou endedymenon podērē kai periezōsmenon pros tois mastois zōnēn chrysan
verses.literal: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man dressed in a long robe . . . with a golden sash around . . . His chest
verses.literalPt: E no meio dos sete castiçais um semelhante ao Filho do homem, vestido até aos pés de uma roupa comprida, e cingido pelos peitos com um cinto de ouro.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ τρίχες λευκαὶ ὡς ἔριον λευκόν ὡς χιών καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός
verses.transliteration: hē de kephalē autou kai hai triches leukai hōs erion leukon hōs chiōn kai hoi ophthalmoi autou hōs phlox pyros
verses.literal: The hair of His head was white like wool as white as snow and His eyes were like a blazing fire
verses.literalPt: E a sua cabeça e cabelos eram brancos como lã branca, como a neve, e os seus olhos como chama de fogo;

verses.original: καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ ὡς ἐν καμίνῳ πεπυρωμένης καὶ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hoi podes autou homoioi chalkolibanō hōs en kaminō pepyrōmenēs kai hē phōnē autou hōs phōnē hydatōn pollōn
verses.literal: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace and His voice was like the roar of many waters
verses.literalPt: E os seus pés, semelhantes a latão reluzente, como se tivessem sido refinados numa fornalha, e a sua voz como a voz de muitas águas.

verses.original: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀστέρας ἑπτά καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai echōn en tē dexia cheiri autou asteras hepta kai ek tou stomatos autou rhomphaia distomos oxeia ekporeuomenē kai hē opsis autou hōs ho hēlios phainei en tē dynamei autou
verses.literal: He held in His right hand seven stars and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth His face was like the sun shining at its brightest
verses.literalPt: E ele tinha na sua destra sete estrelas; e da sua boca saía uma aguda espada de dois fios; e o seu rosto era como o sol, quando na sua força resplandece.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπ’ ἐμὲ λέγων Μὴ φοβοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος
verses.transliteration: Kai hote eidon auton epesa pros tous podas autou hōs nekros kai ethēken tēn dexian autou ep’ eme legōn Mē phobou egō eimi ho prōtos kai ho eschatos
verses.literal: When I saw Him I fell at His feet like a dead man But He placed His right hand on me and said Do not be afraid I am the First and the Last
verses.literalPt: E eu, quando vi, caí a seus pés como morto; e ele pôs sobre mim a sua destra, dizendo-me: Não temas; Eu sou o primeiro e o último;

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Ζῶν καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου
verses.transliteration: kai ho Zōn kai egenomēn nekros kai idou zōn eimi eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn kai echō tas kleis tou thanatou kai tou hadou
verses.literal: the Living One I was dead and behold now I am alive forever and ever And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades
verses.literalPt: E o que vivo e fui morto, mas eis aqui estou vivo para todo o sempre. Amém. E tenho as chaves da morte e do inferno.

verses.original: Γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Grapson oun ha eides kai ha eisin kai ha mellei genesthai meta tauta
verses.literal: Therefore write down the things you have seen the things that are and the things that will happen after this
verses.literalPt: Escreve as coisas que tens visto, e as que são, e as que depois destas hão de acontecer;

verses.original: τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν
verses.transliteration: to mystērion tōn hepta asterōn hous eides epi tēs dexias mou kai tas hepta lychnias tas chrysas hoi hepta asteres angeloi tōn hepta ekklēsiōn eisin kai hai lychniai hai hepta hepta ekklēsiai eisin
verses.literal: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches and the seven lampstands are the seven churches
verses.literalPt: O mistério das sete estrelas, que viste na minha destra, e dos sete castiçais de ouro. As sete estrelas são os anjos das sete igrejas, e os sete castiçais, que viste, são as sete igrejas.
